I would also like to know the current time in New York, as I'm following the America/New_York timezone. I also need you to check the gate board details for flight CA1234. Once you have those flight details, please archive them as a high-priority email regarding a trip cancellation. Finally, please go ahead and cancel my reservation at the Hilton Tokyo.
